blocks:
I wouldn’t assume bringing the records only at drop-off is enough. Happy Tails’ website says dogs must have written proof from their veterinary clinic for Rabies, Distemper/Parvo, and Bordetella, and that requirements must be met before boarding. It recommends vaccinations be given two weeks before boarding. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/vaccination-requirements-policies))

For Charlie’s January 26, 2027 stay, contact them ahead of time to confirm how they want the records submitted and verified. I can’t confirm a booking or whether that date is available.
